title: update

goal.text: Refresh the published claw-kit CLI and Cindy plugin installation.

requirements.summary: Refresh the global CLI first, refresh Cindy from the published Cindy plugin package second, then verify both installed surfaces and report exact status.
acceptanceCriteria: The published global `@veewo/claw` CLI and Cindy plugin are both refreshed.
Cindy uses the `chanyuenpang/claw-kit` published plugin package and only the installed Cindy plugin id `claw-kit` remains enabled.
CLI, marketplace source, enabled identity, source manifest, and cache manifest are verified against the target version.
The result reports exact success or failure for each surface.

tasks.title: Confirm the published target version and official Cindy source
tasks.detail: Tell the user a newer claw-kit version was detected. Confirm the target version is published and available from the official package and `chanyuenpang/claw-kit` GitHub marketplace before changing local installs. A release workflow must publish and verify first.

tasks.title: Refresh the CLI and Cindy plugin
tasks.detail: Refresh the global CLI first. Inside this repository use `npm run install:local-cli`, then `npm run install:cindy-plugin`; the Cindy installer reads the published GitHub `main` marketplace snapshot. On another Cindy machine, add `chanyuenpang/claw-kit --ref main` for first setup or upgrade the `claw-kit` marketplace, then install or enable the installed Cindy plugin id `claw-kit`. Disable any local claw-kit identity. Do not install from unpublished workspace files or a local marketplace.

default.summary: The CLI and Cindy plugin refresh commands completed; verify both installed surfaces.
nextsteps: Verify the official Cindy marketplace source, enabled identity, and matching manifests.

tasks.title: Verify the CLI and Cindy plugin
tasks.detail: Run `claw --version` and `npm list -g @veewo/claw --depth=0`. Verify the installed Cindy plugin id `claw-kit` is enabled, any local claw-kit identity is disabled, and the official marketplace source manifest plus matching cache manifest equal the published target version. Confirm the active cache contains planning, config, update, create-claw-skill, and knowledge-writer, with repository-local release-claw-kit and retired truth-writer and adr-writer absent. Restart Cindy and start a new task before validating the loaded skill version. Report exact success or failure for both surfaces.

references.why: Preserves the direct Cindy update workflow when the claw template cannot run.
Maps Cindy update requirements to this skill package.

rules: Do not route or ask about another host; this is the Cindy update workflow.
Publish and verify the target version before release-time installation refresh.
Use only the published Cindy plugin package and claw-kit@claw-kit identity.
Do not claim success unless both CLI and Cindy plugin verification pass.
